questions.question: A startup expects unpredictable traffic and wants to avoid buying servers upfront. What property of AWS addresses this?
questions.explanation: On-demand, easily scaled resources match unpredictable load without upfront purchase; leasing, colocation and annual-only reservations all fix capacity in advance.

questions.question: A company wants to move nightly backups off its own tape library to managed cloud storage. Is this a typical AWS use case?
options: Yes, backup and storage is a core use case
questions.explanation: Backup and storage is listed as a core AWS use case; the other options wrongly restrict AWS to a single workload or industry.

questions.question: Which statement best describes AWS?
options: A cloud provider offering on-demand services
questions.explanation: AWS provides servers and services on demand; it does not sell hardware, resell licences or provide home internet access.

questions.question: Which list contains only AWS use cases named in the course?
options: Gaming, website hosting, big data analytics
questions.explanation: Gaming, website hosting and big data analytics are named use cases; the other lists mix in physical services AWS does not provide.
